users.table:
CREATE TABLE users (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	login VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	password VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	full_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	role VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	created_by UUID, 
	created_at DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (login), 
	FOREIGN KEY(created_by) REFERENCES users (id)
)

animals.table:
CREATE TABLE animals (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	created_by UUID, 
	created_at DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_animals_name UNIQUE (name), 
	FOREIGN KEY(created_by) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)

categories.table:
CREATE TABLE categories (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	unit VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	created_by UUID, 
	created_at DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(created_by) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

notification_settings.table:
CREATE TABLE notification_settings (
	user_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	web_push_enabled BOOLEAN DEFAULT false NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (user_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

refresh_tokens.table:
CREATE TABLE refresh_tokens (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	user_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	hashed_token VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	expires_at DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL, 
	created_at DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

web_push_subscriptions.table:
CREATE TABLE web_push_subscriptions (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	user_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	endpoint TEXT NOT NULL, 
	p256dh VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	auth VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_web_push_subscriptions_endpoint UNIQUE (endpoint), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

breeds.table:
CREATE TABLE breeds (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	animal_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	created_by UUID, 
	created_at DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_breeds_animal_id_name UNIQUE (animal_id, name), 
	FOREIGN KEY(animal_id) REFERENCES animals (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(created_by) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)

pets.table:
CREATE TABLE pets (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	user_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	breed_id UUID, 
	name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	birth_date DOUBLE PRECISION, 
	photo_key VARCHAR(255), 
	generated_avatar_key VARCHAR(255), 
	avatar_source VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(breed_id) REFERENCES breeds (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)

events.table:
CREATE TABLE events (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	pet_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	type VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	schedule DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL, 
	period VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	description VARCHAR(2000), 
	done_at DOUBLE PRECISION, 
	created_at DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(pet_id) REFERENCES pets (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
indexes: CREATE INDEX idx_events_status_schedule ON events (status, schedule)

food.table:
CREATE TABLE food (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	pet_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	weight INTEGER, 
	ingredients JSONB NOT NULL, 
	is_approach BOOLEAN, 
	is_tolerability BOOLEAN, 
	consequences VARCHAR(1000), 
	created_at DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(pet_id) REFERENCES pets (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
indexes: CREATE INDEX idx_food_pet_id_created_at ON food (pet_id, created_at)

notes.table:
CREATE TABLE notes (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	pet_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	content VARCHAR(2000) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(pet_id) REFERENCES pets (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

states.table:
CREATE TABLE states (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	pet_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	category_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	value INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	note VARCHAR(1000), 
	time DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL, 
	created_at DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(pet_id) REFERENCES pets (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(category_id) REFERENCES categories (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
indexes: CREATE INDEX idx_states_pet_id_category_id_time ON states (pet_id, category_id, time)

notifications.table:
CREATE TABLE notifications (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	event_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	time DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL, 
	created_at DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL, 
	delivered_at DOUBLE PRECISION, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(event_id) REFERENCES events (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
indexes: CREATE INDEX idx_notifications_status_time ON notifications (status, time)
